title: Knee pain, intermediate, dumbbells
message: I'm 41 and I've lifted on and off for a few years. My right knee hurts going down stairs and when I jump; my physio says it's patellofemoral pain and cleared me to train around it. I want to get stronger. I can train 4 days a week, 45 minutes each. Home gym: adjustable dumbbells and a flat bench.

checks.why: impact and deep knee bending aggravate patellofemoral pain
